objective: Resolve empirically whether a CONTRACT (outcome objectives + deterministic guardrails) keeps a real downstream worker (opencode) more on-outcome than a spec or a bare prompt, AND whether a deterministic fidelity-check suffices or a neural judge catches violations the guardrails miss. Build the deterministic fidelity-check (scoring instrument + shippable product) and use it, alongside a marked neural-judge arm, to score a pre-registered, controls-first 3-arm screen on real opencode workers. Pillar 1 of rung-C; the verdict decides the contract-schema shape.
recommendation: GATE CLOSED. Phase 100 is a MEASUREMENT phase (rung-C analogue of the amplifier-screen lineage Ph70/71/77/78/80). Build the deterministic fidelity-check (dual-use: scorer + shippable artifact, no precommitment to A1), then run a pre-registered, controls-first screen comparing {contract, spec, bare-baseline} arms on real opencode workers (opencode run --pure --format json) in a non-leaking scratch workspace, scored by BOTH the deterministic check and a calibrated neural judge. The frozen decision rule yields the verdict; a conclusive contract-beats-spec result ships the contract schema, else it routes to a build phase.

options.label: A' — Build-the-check + run the contract-vs-spec screen
options.description: Build the deterministic fidelity-check (instrument + product). Run opencode workers on a task set under {contract, spec, bare-baseline} in a --pure / scratch-CWD non-leaking workspace; score fidelity with the deterministic check AND a marked neural-judge arm; pre-register + freeze the decision rule; seed a violating output the check MUST catch (clean-on-seed = dead). Verdict decides the contract-schema shape. Threads A4-ship with A1/A2-measure.

options.label: B' — Measurement-only verdict (Ph97/98 style)
options.description: Run the screen entirely in gitignored companion/research/; ship NOTHING this phase; the build becomes a verdict-gated Phase 101. Cleanest de-risking, but conflicts with A4-accept.

options.label: C' — Build-first (original Option A, superseded)
options.description: Build + seed-test + ship the contract spine now. Rejected by A1/A2 don't-know: it ships the contract artifact before measuring whether it beats a spec.

assumptions.text: A new contract artifact earns its complexity over reusing success:/spec (the subtraction-test fork).
assumptions.resolution: CONVERTED to the phase's measurement target: the 3-arm fidelity screen on real opencode workers decides it. Not a silent pass — it is the deliverable's question.

assumptions.text: The fidelity spine is deterministic-only (no LLM judge in the acceptance path).
assumptions.resolution: CONVERTED to measurement via R1: BOTH a deterministic scorer and a marked neural-judge arm run; their agreement measures whether a judge catches fidelity violations the deterministic guardrails miss.

assumptions.text: Pillar 1 is validated against SEEDED worker outputs; no real worker this phase.
assumptions.resolution: ABSORBED: a real opencode worker IS the measurement instrument. A minimal slice of pillar-2 (real worker execution) merges in for the measurement; the 24/7 fleet stays later.

assumptions.text: Pillar 1 ships to the kit (scripts/ + Makefile + tests/), not gitignored companion/research/.
assumptions.resolution: Holds for the deterministic fidelity-CHECK (dual-use). Contract-SCHEMA shape deferred to the verdict (R3). The opencode harness + runs + results are measurement apparatus → companion/research/.

assumptions.text: Fidelity metric: deterministic-only, vs deterministic + a marked neural-judge arm.
assumptions.resolution: Maintainer chose DETERMINISTIC + a marked neural-judge arm. The screen scores every run twice (machine-checkable guardrails AND a calibrated, exemplar-anchored judge per the Ph44-50 method, cross-model to avoid self-grading bias); deterministic-vs-judge agreement answers A2. Task corpus must include a subjective quality dimension so the two scorers CAN disagree.

assumptions.text: Screen arms + decision rule: 3-arm {contract, spec, bare-baseline} with a frozen pre-registered rule, vs contract-vs-spec head-to-head only.
assumptions.resolution: Accepted: 3 arms + a frozen decision rule (contract must beat spec by a pre-stated margin on fidelity to justify a contract artifact). The bare-baseline is the amplifier-null guard — it caught every prior null.

assumptions.text: Deliverable split: ship the deterministic fidelity-CHECK; defer the contract-schema shape to the verdict.
assumptions.resolution: Accepted: the check ships to scripts/ + make + tests/ (instrument now, product later). The contract-schema ships in this phase only if the verdict is conclusive; else routes to a build phase.

context.active_phase: Phase 99 — Direction Dashboard (delivered + accepted 2026-06-22); Phase 100 = a measurement screen (gate closed 2026-06-22).
open_decisions: Method (STATED): non-leaking workspace (--pure + scratch CWD, worker sees ONLY the variant input — Ph80 leak hazard); pre-registered + byte-frozen decision rule (Ph87/97 three-tier discipline); seeded positive control for BOTH scorers; apparatus in gitignored companion/research/, shippable check in scripts/.
Judge calibration: exemplar-anchored, cross-model, self-grading-bias-aware (Ph44-50 prior art).
Pillar 2 full scope (24/7 opencode fleet) stays a later phase; minimal real worker as instrument only.
